name: Discovery (STS 51-A)
about: Discovery (STS 51-A) (1984-113A), a crewed vehicle (OV-103), launched 1984 Nov  8. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1984 Nov 10), held fixed
GCAT names the site (KSC RW15); its coordinates are written from memory
